title: Database Engine Selection
context: The system integrates with SAP S/4HANA which uses SAP HANA as its database engine.
decision: Use SAP HANA-compatible schema generation for all persistent data models.

title: ERP Integration Strategy
context: Multiple integration points exist between the domain and SAP S/4HANA.
decision: Route all ERP traffic through an adapter layer that delegates to the erp-surface client.

title: Deployment Target
context: The service must be deployed as a stateless workload.
decision: Deploy on Cloud Run with IAM-scoped service accounts.
